Expected Values: HTTPS, ssh://user@host/path, or user@host:path Git URL; e.g. https://gitlab.com/team/app.git

Requirements: Nonempty for every job, including single-platform jobs. Required key in setup answers, including when unused. Values are case-sensitive, single-line and trimmed.

Default Value: No implicit default; save a value per job
Description: Public Dart define. Setup rejects credentials, whitespace, query/fragment, backticks, dollar signs, backslashes, quotes and angle brackets.

Expected Values: Exactly 10 uppercase letters/digits, e.g. ABCDE12345; empty when no iOS release is selected

Description: Apple developer team used to build/export. Use the actual team, not the example.
